senses.gloss: סָרֵיג ch. same, to strap, saddle, harness.—Part. pass. מְסָרַג.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 57b:7">Ber. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>הא דמס׳</he> (Ar. <he>דמסורג</he>, h. form) in the one case the elephant was seen saddled.
B. Bath. 73ᵃ הוה מְסָרְגָאן ליה וכ׳ (Ms. R. a. Rashb. סְרִיגָן, Ms. O. שְׂרִיגָן, Part. pass. Pe.) two mules were saddled for him.—[Targ. Job XIV, 5, v. סְרִיג.]
